_comment: System-level rule references for Mutants & Masterminds 4e (Open Game Content). The trait keys, formulas, sentinel scope strings, and structural modifier ids that core resolvers read instead of hardcoding them in Python (docs/mm-core-mechanics.md §5-8). Consumed by mm_companion.core.data_loader; a mod can override any of these.

system._criticals: A natural 20 on an attack is a critical hit: the effect it lands gains criticalEffectBonus to its resistance DC. A natural 1 that still hits is a graze, and the target resists at criticalMissResistanceBonus.
system._quick_npc: The GM's Quick NPC presets. A quick NPC is six numbers (attack, effect, defence, toughness, fortitude, will) set from a Power Level. Each pair shares the costs.json power_level cap named by its 'cap', whose total is mult x PL + add. A preset gives each stat a share of that total: 'high' is high_share of it rounded up, 'low' is what 'high' leaves, 'even' is half, 'random' is anywhere from low to high. A 'fill' pair sums to its cap exactly: the stat the preset names takes its share and the other the remainder (name one stat per fill pair; if both are named, the pair's first stat wins). A pair that does not fill sets each stat on its own share and never passes the cap between them. A stat a preset does not name takes 'even'.

presets.name: Brute
presets.description: Hits hard and shrugs blows off, but is easy to hit and hits less often.

presets.name: Speed
presets.description: Accurate and hard to hit, but its blows are light and it goes down easily.

presets.name: Balance
presets.description: An even split: attack and effect, defence and toughness, half each.

presets.name: Random
presets.description: Every number somewhere between a third and two thirds of its cap. Click again to re-roll.

system._damage_effect: Which effect's resistance ladder is the generic damage ladder — the one the GM's quick-damage buttons walk. Named here rather than spelled in Python, so a ruleset whose damage effect is called something else retargets it.
system._improvised_effects: Improvised Effects (p101-102): preparing one takes a time rank equal to its Power Point cost, never less than minTimeRank. Each time rank shaved off adds dcPerTimeRankSaved to the preparation DC; each one added grants checkBonusPerTimeRankSpent on the check. Both DCs are defense_dc_base plus the effect's cost.
system._extra_effort: Extra Effort (p20-21): a non-action that buys one of the listed benefits and costs a rung of the fatigue ladder at the start of your next turn. rankIncrease is what the Rank Increase use grants before Untapped Potential adds its ranks; checkBonus is what the Bonus use is worth. permanentDurations are the durations Extra Effort cannot improve or stunt with (p104, p159). The three advantages are named here rather than in Python: Determination shrugs the fatigue off, Untapped Potential deepens the rank increase, Extraordinary Effort buys two benefits for two rungs.

extra_effort._pushableTraits: The rank increase may also name your Strength (for Damage or Lifting) or your Speed rank in one mode of movement you have (p21). A movement entry names no stat: which modes a character has is a fact about the sheet, not the ruleset, so it is expanded per character.

pushableTraits.label: Speed
pushableTraits.note: in one mode of movement you have

uses.label: Extra action
uses.description: An extra standard or simple action on your turn, or an extra reaction at any time.

uses.label: Bonus on a check
uses.description: A +2 bonus on a single check, raising an existing bonus or cancelling a penalty.

uses.label: Rank increase
uses.description: Raise the rank of one non-permanent effect until the end of your turn, past the Power Level limits — or your Strength, or your Speed in one mode of movement you have.

uses.label: Power stunt
uses.description: Use a temporary Alternate Effect of a non-permanent effect you have. The GM has final say over which stunts make sense.

uses.label: Renewed attempt
uses.description: Attempt something again that would otherwise take until the next scene.

uses.label: Resistance check
uses.description: Immediately make another resistance check against an ongoing effect.
